title: Ggaba Lakeside Market
description: Farm-gate vegetables, roasted corn, crafts, and live music on the Ggaba shore. Come hungry and bring the family.

title: Silent Disco Friday — Three Channels
description: Dance to Afrobeat, house, or kidandali on your own headphones while the neighbours get an undisturbed night’s sleep.

title: Live Jazz Set
description: The house trio, a sax feature, and an espresso martini that the regulars insist must be had at ten o’clock.

title: Blitz Chess Night
description: Five-minute chess across sixty boards, with the house champion defending the corner table all evening.

title: Five-a-Side League Night
description: Floodlit pitches and corporate-league fixtures across three divisions. Boots and water provided for walk-ons.

title: Sunrise Group Run
description: Pace groups for every level around the Naguru routes, with water stops and a coffee stop after.

title: Cupping Hour + Discount Blends
description: Taste the week’s single origins straight from the roaster, then take 10% off the blend of the day.

title: Tuesday Night Book Club
description: Cozy armchairs, strong opinions, and a rotating pick of Ugandan and African literature. Newcomers welcomed loudly.

title: Hands-on Pottery for Beginners
description: Throw, trim, and glaze your own mug in a single afternoon. Firing takes a week and is worth the wait.

title: Old Town Poetry Open Mic
description: Spoken word, acoustic sets, and standing-room-only crowds below the old cathedral on Kampala Hill.

title: Open Streets Kololo
description: The city closes a strip of Kololo to cars for running, skating, and aerobics — breakfast carts until it reopens.

title: Nile Riverbank Clean-Up
description: Gloves, bags, and breakfast after. The stretch below the dam is spotless because of them.

title: Sunrise Paddle from Entebbe
description: Guided kayaks from the botanical shore before the lake heats up. First-timers and the sure-paddled both welcome.

title: Open Drum Jam
description: Drums of every size and a circle that anyone can join. Calloused hands and open ears encouraged.

title: Build Night — Laser Cutter Intro
description: Bring a project or start one. Coffee arrives at eight; the laser cutter books out fast.

title: Ggaba Pool Party
description: Sand, swimming, sunsets, and sound — the weekend beach club at full throttle on the Ggaba shore.

title: Women in Tech Demo Night
description: Code-along evening and mini demos, celebrating women building in Kampala’s tech scene.

title: Ugandan Shorts + Talkback
description: New Ugandan short films, world cinema, and a talkback that always runs long. Popcorn is good.

title: Mabira Forest Hike
description: A forest-loop hike out of the city with transport and lunch sorted, plus a waterfall reward at the turn.

title: Sunrise Zumba at Kisementi
description: Open-air cardio that feels like a party, on Kisementi’s green before the city wakes.

title: Sunday Lane Swimming
description: Quiet lanes, warm water, and a sauna round the back to finish your Sunday morning.

title: Music, Dance & Storytelling Night
description: Nightly shows of music, dance, and storytelling from across Uganda’s regions. Come for the sundowner, stay for the finale.
